name: Generic Feed
label: Generic Feed
description: A generic RSS feed, configured by your agent — paste the prompt, give it a feed URL, and it shows one entry at a time.

ui.title: Generic Feed
ui.help: Shows one entry at a time. Ask your agent to point it at a feed URL, then use Previous and Next to move between entries.

set_feed.description: Set the full RSS feed XML, newest first, at most 14 entries.
